Token-bounded extraction removes all dependence on whether a parser closes the paragraph.

semantic_text_normalization.entity_before_nfc: character-reference resolution occurs BEFORE NFC. "é" resolves to U+0065 U+0301 and then NFC yields the canonical composed form where applicable. NFC-first is FORBIDDEN: it would leave a reference-encoded decomposed sequence unnormalized and make the classifier outcome order-dependent.
semantic_text_normalization.evidence_note: h3.title and p.article__time were already clean ASCII on 5/5 samples; only the release leading segment carried trailing LF and multiple spaces, so collapse and trim are REQUIRED there. NFC, NBSP and character references were NOT exercised by the sample - the pipeline is frozen for determinism, not because the sample demonstrated a need.
semantic_text_normalization.nbsp_rule: U+00A0 is NOT in the ASCII whitespace set. " " resolves to U+00A0 and is NOT collapsed to U+0020 by this pipeline. No browser-layout whitespace equivalence is introduced.
order: 1. HTML_CHARACTER_REFERENCE_RESOLUTION_DURING_FIELD_EXTRACTION - extract text ONLY from the frozen field-specific source: for title and date the semantic text of the unique authoritative node; for release the token-bounded leading segment defined above
2. UNICODE_NFC
3. COLLAPSE_ASCII_WHITESPACE_TO_U0020 - every maximal run of one or more ASCII whitespace code points becomes exactly one U+0020
4. TRIM_U0020 - trim leading and trailing U+0020
5. FIELD_SPECIFIC_EXACT_COMPARE_OR_STRICT_PARSE

normalization_order: 1. extract the charset/encoding value under its metadata syntax, removing syntax-level quoting only where that syntax permits it: HTTP parameter double quotes, XML attribute single/double quotes, HTML attribute single/double quotes; unquoted values remain allowed only where their metadata syntax allows them

2. trim only surrounding ASCII whitespace permitted by that metadata syntax; the possible characters are U+0009, U+000A, U+000C, U+000D and U+0020, restricted to those the relevant syntax permits. Do not trim Unicode whitespace or alter internal label characters
3. map ASCII A-Z to a-z only; no Unicode case folding or normalization
4. accept if and only if the entire resulting label is exactly utf-8 or utf8; both name the single UTF-8 codec. Every other, empty or malformed label fails with PARSER_FAILED

triggers: any recognized charset declaration is non-UTF-8, unknown, empty or malformed
a leading UTF-16/UTF-32 BOM is present
the body is not strict UTF-8
required replay charset provenance is missing rather than recording actual header absence
failure.zero_policy: This failed response cannot establish EVENTS_OBSERVED_ZERO. A failed discovery feed or affected primary candidate blocks zero under the existing completeness/unresolved-candidate rules. No broader source-health redesign.

forbidden: browser, locale or platform default encoding
a second decoding attempt with another codec
first-wins or last-wins selection among charset declarations

html_charset_policy.meta_charset_role: A recognized meta charset attribute is a consistency constraint, never a decoder selector. Validate every such declaration, not just the first or last.
html_charset_policy.meta_http_equiv_role: Recognize meta http-equiv=Content-Type with charset parameters in its content attribute as charset consistency signals. Match HTML attribute names and the http-equiv Content-Type value ASCII case-insensitively. Validate all charset values using the same label policy; this adds no semantic extraction or malformed-HTML recovery policy.
html_charset_policy.multiple_declarations: ALL recognized declarations must resolve to UTF-8. UTF-8 plus utf8 is compatible; UTF-8 plus windows-1252, another encoding or an unknown label fails. No declaration overrides another.

http_charset_policy.absent_parameter: No HTTP charset signal; do not synthesize a default from HTTP libraries. The sole V1 default remains UTF-8.
http_charset_policy.role: CONSISTENCY_CONSTRAINT_ONLY - every charset parameter in the persisted Content-Type values must resolve to UTF-8 under charset_label_policy. Multiple values must all agree on UTF-8; no first-wins/last-wins rule and no alternate decoder selection.

inputs: verified complete admitted body bytes, unchanged including any BOM
exact persisted relevant HTTP Content-Type field values or recorded actual header absence, as required by raw_policy.content_type_charset_provenance
the exact CaptureSpec hash bound to the revision
offline_replay.missing_metadata: FAIL CLOSED / PARSER_FAILED if required charset provenance was not preserved; never confuse missing provenance with an HTTP header that was actually absent, and never refetch metadata
offline_replay.rule: Same verified body bytes plus the same persisted relevant HTTP metadata plus the same CaptureSpec hash MUST produce the same Unicode text or the same PARSER_FAILED. No network, browser, locale, platform encoding default or machine-dependent codec alias lookup.

order: 1. complete the unchanged bounded HTTP body admission, durable raw-byte persistence and hashing; charset work never precedes these gates, and replay verifies those same stored bytes
2. the codec is already fixed to UTF-8, never inferred. Inspect the leading byte signature under utf8_bom and validate every persisted HTTP charset signal; any incompatible signal fails closed
3. form a text-only view omitting exactly one leading UTF-8 signature if present; strictly decode the entire remaining body as UTF-8 without fallback or lossy error handling

4. validate all recognized XML declaration or HTML meta charset signals on this strict UTF-8 text under the corresponding policy. This validation cannot switch codecs or trigger another decoding attempt; any incompatible declaration rejects the text

5. only after the entire charset/UTF-8 gate passes may text be supplied for XML/HTML semantic extraction and normalization. No semantic parser may override the codec or re-detect encoding from the original bytes
text_decoding_v1.scope_boundary: UTF-8 ONLY is a deliberately narrow V1 admission policy, not a claim that every Federal Reserve document uses UTF-8. FIX9 adds no Unicode NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD or NBSP/whitespace transformation: after removing the one encoding signature, decoded code points are left to the unchanged existing parser policy. XML entities/DTD/expansion, malformed HTML recovery, HTTP status/304, retries, rate windows, scheduler, recheck anchor, restart/overdue handling and timeouts are not redesigned here.
text_decoding_v1.signal_combination: There is no charset precedence competition. Zero recognized signals selects the explicit UTF-8 default. Otherwise EVERY present recognized signal must resolve to UTF-8; any unsupported, unknown or conflicting declaration causes PARSER_FAILED even when the body bytes are otherwise valid UTF-8. A declaration may constrain admission but may never select another decoder.
text_decoding_v1.strict_utf8_semantics: Decode valid UTF-8 Unicode scalar values only. Reject invalid or truncated sequences, stray/invalid continuation bytes, overlong encodings, encoded surrogate code points and values above U+10FFFF. No skipping, replacement, surrogateescape, guessed codec or second attempt.

utf8_bom.position: absolute body-byte offset 0 only, before text decoding
utf8_bom.rule: One leading EF BB BF is a UTF-8 encoding signature compatible with the sole codec. Omit exactly those three bytes from the text-only decoding view so that signature is not exposed as U+FEFF. Never mutate persisted/hash/replay bytes; the BOM still counts toward the existing decoded-body byte cap. Do not strip another BOM or any later U+FEFF code point. A non-UTF-8 declaration still causes failure even with a UTF-8 BOM.
utf8_bom.unsupported_prefix_action: PARSER_FAILED - never select UTF-16 or UTF-32; inspect the listed four-byte prefixes before the overlapping two-byte prefixes

xml_charset_policy.declaration_role: An encoding value in the XML declaration is a consistency constraint under charset_label_policy, not permission to select an XML library's own decoder. Non-UTF-8 or unknown declarations fail even if the bytes happen to be valid UTF-8/ASCII.

xml.external_entity_resolution: MUST BE DISABLED - see xml_security_policy for the full frozen set; this clause alone was found insufficient by R11
xml.security_policy_ref: parser_policy.xml_security_policy (FIX11) - authoritative and broader than the external-entity clause below
xml.unsupported_extensions: ignored unless frozen by a spec revision
xml.xxe_note: XML external entity expansion and network entity resolution are a security requirement, not an optimisation

xml_security_detection.malformed_security_syntax: malformed XML attempting to express a DOCTYPE, entity or XInclude construct falls under the existing malformed-XML policy: PARSER_FAILED, with no repair or fuzzy parsing.
xml_security_detection.rule: detection must follow XML syntactic/token semantics well enough to avoid false positives. A literal "<!DOCTYPE" or "<xi:include" appearing inside an XML COMMENT or CDATA section is not itself a prohibited construct: "<!-- <!DOCTYPE rss> -->" must NOT be rejected merely because the character sequence occurs in comment text. This keeps FIX11 from encouraging unsafe regex parsing.

body_limit_relation.what_the_caps_bound: PARSER INPUT SIZE - decoded HTTP entity-body bytes, enforced incrementally during production per FIX8
body_limit_relation.what_the_caps_do_not_bound: semantic output an XML parser could generate afterwards through DTD, entity or XInclude processing. FIX11 must NOT be read as relying on the body cap for that, and the body cap must NOT be described as bounding parser expansion.

xml_security_policy.doctype_rule: any XML document containing a DOCTYPE declaration is INVALID for FOMC V1 - <!DOCTYPE rss>, <!DOCTYPE rss [...]>, <!DOCTYPE rss SYSTEM "...">, <!DOCTYPE rss PUBLIC "...">. All are PARSER_FAILED. No partial acceptance, no "ignore the DTD and continue", no library-default decision.
xml_security_policy.external_dtd_rule: external DTD retrieval or resolution is forbidden independently of the DOCTYPE ban: no HTTP or HTTPS fetch, no file read, no local URI, no catalog lookup, no custom resolver. A document referencing an external DTD is PARSER_FAILED with NO resource access attempted.
xml_security_policy.external_entity_rule: external general entities and external parameter entities are forbidden: no resolution, no substitution, no external DTD chaining, no network and no local filesystem access. This is stated explicitly rather than left to parser defaults.
xml_security_policy.fail_before_resource_resolution: a prohibited construct must be detected and rejected WITHOUT first resolving it. <!DOCTYPE rss SYSTEM "https://evil.invalid/test.dtd"> must be rejected without fetching that URI, and file:///etc/passwd must never be opened.
xml_security_policy.internal_dtd_subset_rule: forbidden automatically because DOCTYPE is forbidden; no custom entity expansion path exists
xml_security_policy.internal_entity_expansion: NO PERMITTED PATH. Because DOCTYPE is forbidden, no user-defined internal entity can be declared, so the billion-laughs family is rejected at the DOCTYPE gate BEFORE any expansion occurs. V1 therefore needs no entity-count, nesting-depth or expanded-byte cap: the declaration machinery is simply not admitted.
xml_security_policy.network_free_parsing: after the HTTP body is durably available, parsing performs ZERO network requests, DNS lookups, filesystem reads, external catalog lookups or URI dereferences. The only parser input is the verified persisted XML body plus already-persisted metadata the CaptureSpec allows.

numeric_character_references.note: numeric character references remain permitted subject to valid XML and Unicode semantics

xml_security_policy.parser_library_independence: no library is pinned. Any library is acceptable only if configured or enveloped so these frozen semantics hold. LIBRARY DEFAULTS ARE NOT AUTHORITATIVE: an implementation must explicitly ensure DOCTYPE is rejected and that external entities, external DTDs, parameter entities, XInclude and any network/local resolver are unavailable.

predefined_xml_entities.note: the five built-in XML entity references are NOT custom DTD entity declarations and remain valid under normal XML parsing. FIX11 must not reject them.

xml_security_policy.rejection_timing: XML security checks occur BEFORE feed semantic extraction can be considered successful. A document rejected for DOCTYPE, an entity feature, XInclude or an external-resource mechanism yields NO feed items, NO candidate classification and NO EVENTS_OBSERVED_ZERO.
xml_security_policy.replay: offline replay produces exactly the same result: DOCTYPE present -> PARSER_FAILED; XInclude present -> PARSER_FAILED; external entity syntax -> PARSER_FAILED. No network or local-file attempt, so replay never becomes dependent on machine filesystem contents.
xml_security_policy.second_pass_rule: after the initial parse, no resolve_entities, xinclude/process_xinclude, load_dtd, validate-against-external-DTD or any equivalent second pass that can expand or fetch resources may run. No optional parser feature may re-enable prohibited behaviour later.
xml_security_policy.stage: a deterministic PARSER-SECURITY GATE. The body has already passed the HTTP decoded-body cap, raw durability/hashing and the UTF-8 policy under the unchanged raw-first order; FIX11 changes none of those steps.
xml_security_policy.xinclude_rule: XInclude processing must never be invoked, and no inclusion of http://, https://, file://, a relative local path or any other URI may occur. Presence of the XInclude namespace or include construct in the discovery document is PARSER_FAILED. It is deliberately NOT left as an inert unknown element, because that would let different libraries behave differently.

retry_policy.feed_retry_binding: a failed feed poll is followed only by the next poll under revision_policy.reobservation_scheduler.live_feed_cadence
retry_policy.reobservation_retry_binding: revision_policy.reobservation_scheduler.retry_policy (BOUNDED_RETRY_EPISODE_V1): at most 6 logical fetches per episode with backoff 60/300/900/3600/14400 s, then SUSPENDED; discovery-cycle retry never applies to an anchored item
retry_policy.rule: on failure, record source health; any later attempt is only the next normal discovery poll or an attempt permitted by revision_policy.reobservation_scheduler.retry_policy, all under the same ceiling

provider.historical_availability: statement pages retrievable by official archive link; explicit release line verified on samples across 2016-2026
provider.official_contract: no published numeric rate limit; no verified prohibition of automated access
provider.revision_support: UPSTREAM UNKNOWN - handled client-side by content-hash re-observation, never by assuming immutability

active_prior_start_rule.candidate: t is the proposed PHYSICAL_REQUEST_ATTEMPT_START instant in the current limiter epoch monotonic domain; s ranges over prior admitted starts in that same domain.
active_prior_start_rule.equal_timestamp_prior: A previously granted start at the same t cannot permit another start: provider-wide atomic registration makes it the previous_start and t - previous_start = 0 fails the mandatory spacing test.
active_prior_start_rule.exact_comparisons: A prior start of age exactly 60 seconds is excluded; age strictly below 60 and strictly above zero is included. Do not round a candidate across either the window or spacing threshold or apply an early-admission tolerance.
active_prior_start_rule.post_admission_property: For every admitted start t, the interval (t-60s,t] contains at most six admitted PHYSICAL_REQUEST_ATTEMPT_START events.

atomic_steps: 1. Inspect the current provider-wide admitted-start history and obtain candidate monotonic instant t for this decision.
2. Test count({s in history | 0 < t - s < 60}) <= 5.
3. Test t - previous_start >= 10, or pass spacing if no previous admitted start exists in this epoch.
4. Only if all preconditions and both tests pass, atomically grant, consume exactly one unit and register t in window/spacing history before another candidate can be granted.
5. Immediately initiate this attempt through the transport; no DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP side effect precedes registration.
admission.cancel_after_grant: The consumed unit is not refunded even if cancellation occurs before network I/O. Its t remains in the rolling-window and spacing histories under their normal age rules; no successful SourceObservation or EventRevision is implied.
admission.failed_admission: No grant means no physical attempt start, no network side effect and no consumed unit; pending work may be considered again when all conditions permit.
admission.immediate_initiation: A grant is not a detachable permit. It belongs to one immediate physical-attempt initiation. If the task cannot proceed after grant, abandon that authorization while keeping its consumed start; a future attempt must obtain a fresh admission. Waiting, rescheduling or another epoch cannot revive a previous grant.
admission.preconditions: Request/URL validation and any waiting precede the grant. Exclusive provider ownership and elapsed_since_limiter_epoch_begin >= 60 MUST hold before a candidate can be granted.
admission.semantic_instant: The atomic provider-limiter grant-and-consume event immediately before transport invocation for ONE validated request. This is the SAME event/timestamp for physical accounting, rolling-window history and start-to-start spacing; neither response completion nor socket write supplies a separate rate timestamp.

algorithm.alternative_algorithms: FORBIDDEN - no fixed UTC/calendar-minute bucket, token bucket or leaky bucket; no calendar-minute reset.

candidate_59_999.verdict: WAIT - both window and spacing fail; no start and no accounting unit consumed.

boundary_examples.time_origin: Unless an example explicitly uses epoch elapsed e, t=0 is an arbitrary origin AFTER the current epoch cold-start embargo, with exclusive ownership already established. Example starts at t=0 do not bypass startup embargo.

category_rules.feed_primary: Feed start at 100 and immediate statement discovery cannot permit primary start before 110, subject also to the rolling window.
category_rules.historical: Historical provider capture under this same CaptureSpec/client follows the identical limiter and has no separate capacity or fast lane.
category_rules.reattempt: Existing polling.retry_policy is unchanged. Each legitimately permitted later attempt obtains a fresh admission; no hidden transport retry or free retry.
category_rules.recheck: Being due grants no immediate network permission. Recheck work waits until limiter conditions pass; which eligible work takes a grant is frozen by revision_policy.reobservation_scheduler.selection.
category_rules.redirect: Every validated redirect-follow GET independently reacquires this same rolling-window, start-spacing, monotonic and atomic provider gate; no immediate auto-follow bypass.

clock.rule: All live window, spacing and embargo elapsed comparisons use one comparable monotonic domain within the limiter epoch. Wall UTC remains recorded request/observation provenance under existing causal semantics only; it cannot accelerate or reset rate admission.

concurrency.ownership_failure: If exclusive provider admission ownership cannot be established, no provider network attempt may start. Fail closed operationally without adding a source-health enum.
concurrency.rule: All concurrent FOMC V1 emitters, including multiple processes, must share the same provider-wide atomic admission semantics and comparable current-epoch history. A centralized issuer or coordinated interprocess admission may provide this; category/process separation cannot create independent capacity. No mutex, async lock, database, file lock or IPC primitive is prescribed.
concurrency.simultaneous_workers: With five active prior starts and spacing otherwise permitting, at most one simultaneous candidate is admitted first. After its registration the other candidate MUST evaluate updated state; a same-instant candidate fails spacing with delta zero. No simultaneous provider starts.

limiter_epoch.after_embargo: Current-epoch history is empty before its first admitted start. At elapsed 60 seconds, embargo passes; normal rolling-window and spacing admission then applies. Subsequent starts update the fresh monotonic history.
applies_on: provider limiter recreation with a fresh non-comparable monotonic epoch
limiter_epoch.definition: One continuous provider runtime epoch in which all admitted-start monotonic history is available and comparable in one domain.
limiter_epoch.epoch_begin: The new admission epoch begins only after exclusive provider ownership is established and previous independent issuers can no longer initiate provider attempts. Time waiting while an old independent issuer retains emission authority cannot count toward the new epoch embargo.
limiter_epoch.no_cross_epoch_reconstruction: Do not compare or reuse precise prior-epoch monotonic timestamps for admission. No precise elapsed history is reconstructed from a new epoch. Safety uses exclusive provider ownership plus the FULL 60-second embargo measured in the NEW epoch.
limiter_epoch.ownership_continuity: A new process must not wait out an embargo in parallel with an independently active old issuer and then begin a separate budget. Ownership must exclude overlapping independent admission epochs; if that cannot be established, no new provider attempt. A fresh non-comparable epoch after ownership is re-established receives its full embargo.
limiter_epoch.safety_argument: Exclusive handoff prevents further starts from the old epoch. After 60 new-epoch monotonic seconds every unknown prior-epoch start is at least 60 seconds old and outside the strict-left rolling window. The embargo also exceeds the 10-second spacing requirement; no cross-epoch timestamp comparison or durable request-start history is required.
limiter_epoch.wall_utc_shortcut: FORBIDDEN - UTC history, persisted request times or an apparent long downtime cannot shorten or bypass the embargo.

rate_limiter.scope_boundary: FIX15 freezes the complete provider rate-admission contract only. Scheduling, overdue/coalescing/fairness (revision_policy.reobservation_scheduler), the physical-attempt deadline (http_policy.physical_attempt_deadline), source-health classification (source_health) and EST/EDT labels (timestamps.release_time.zone_label_policy) are frozen by FIX18 without changing any rate-admission rule.

spacing.completion_time_role: NONE - completion time does not set or shift the spacing reference. A starts at 0, completes at 45, B candidate at 45: spacing passes with delta 45, subject to the rolling-window condition. No completion + 10 rule.
spacing.no_previous_start: Spacing passes when current-epoch history has no admitted start; exclusive ownership and cold-start embargo still MUST pass.
spacing.previous_start: The immediately previous admitted provider-wide PHYSICAL_REQUEST_ATTEMPT_START in this epoch, including a grant followed by cancellation or transport failure.

wait_semantics.description: Work remains pending; this is not a source-health classification or a new enum.
wait_semantics.earliest_eligible_start: With ownership established, pending work is constrained by epoch_begin + 60 seconds, previous_start + 10 seconds if present, and the first instant with at most five active prior starts under 0 < t - s < 60. All conditions must hold together and be evaluated against current state at admission. Eligibility is not a reservation or a promise of queue ordering/service.

raw_policy.bytes_semantics: raw_body_bytes = the entity body AFTER standard HTTP content decoding; Content-Encoding retained as metadata
raw_policy.charset: ONLY parser_policy.text_decoding_v1 applies, AFTER complete bounded body admission, durable raw persistence and byte hashing. XML and HTML use STRICT UTF-8, also the explicit default; every recognized declaration must be UTF-8-compatible. Unsupported/conflicting/unknown charset, unsupported BOM or invalid UTF-8 => PARSER_FAILED with raw/hash preserved, no EventRevision and no zero from the failed feed/candidate. No fallback or lossy decoding.
raw_policy.content_type_charset_provenance: The existing persisted Content-Type provenance MUST preserve the exact relevant received field value(s), including charset parameters, duplicates and source spelling, or explicitly record that the header was absent. Never replace them with a library-inferred default charset, keep only the media type, or discard a conflicting value. These values and the unchanged body bytes are required offline inputs to parser_policy.text_decoding_v1. Missing recorded provenance is not equivalent to actual header absence: fail closed, no metadata refetch. This clarifies existing HTTP provenance, not a new raw/EventStore schema.
raw_policy.corrupt_raw_at_replay: verified replay FAILS CLOSED (design NORMALIZED_PRESENT_RAW_CORRUPT); raw_policy.integrity_verification applies the same rule outside replay
raw_policy.hash_algorithm_note: repo primitive sha256_bytes; no second digest algorithm introduced
raw_policy.hash_is_not_vintage_proof: the raw body hash is provenance for WHAT HYPRL ACTUALLY OBSERVED AND WHEN. It does not become proof of historical content existence merely because the same normalized record also carries a declared_release_at recovered from the page.

integrity_verification.later_detection: a mismatch found after a terminal outcome exists is recorded as a separate durable integrity diagnostic (live operation only); dependent revisions are NORMALIZED_PRESENT_RAW_CORRUPT and verified snapshots depending on them fail closed
on_mismatch: no parse and no normalization from those bytes
if the record has no terminal processing outcome yet, persist CORRUPTION_FAIL_CLOSED as its terminal outcome (live operation only); an existing terminal outcome is never replaced
no network repair and no scheduler refetch triggered by the corruption (raw_policy.network_repair FORBIDDEN)
every normalized EventRevision bound to that raw hash is NORMALIZED_PRESENT_RAW_CORRUPT: verified snapshots depending on it fail closed; the revision row is not deleted or silently recomputed
a feed record found corrupt: verified replay of its discovery cycle fails closed; the durable cycle conclusion is never rewritten
integrity_verification.replay_writes: replay is read-only: it never persists outcomes or diagnostics; it fails closed
integrity_verification.rule: Every consumer of persisted raw bytes - normal post-durable processing, restart recovery, scheduler reconciliation that reads bytes, and replay - MUST verify the stored SHA-256 before use. A digest mismatch is FAIL CLOSED everywhere, not only at replay.
integrity_verification.scheduler_effect: Satisfaction derived from the record's durable metadata stands (the observation happened); corruption never re-opens an obligation and never triggers traffic.

offline_replay.digest_mismatch: FAIL CLOSED (raw_policy.corrupt_raw_at_replay): no parser, no normalized output, no zero, no repair fetch
offline_replay.hash_persist_replay_identity: admitted body bytes hashed == bytes persisted == bytes replayed (raw_policy.bytes_semantics, http_policy.decoded_body_limit_enforcement.raw_replay_preservation)
